Fixed as a systemic, check-agnostic reuse authority rather than a per-check cache: (1) scripts/ops/evidence_scope.py owns the only reusable/affected/blocked decision for any declared-unit surface, executes nothing, forbids recording a unit the run did not execute and forbids skipping a planned unit, and only carries forward passed/checked/declared/reused outcomes; scripts/ops/test_evidence_scope.py (25 tests, make verify.frontend.business_entry.evidence_scope.unit) locks the semantics. (2) All frontend_/business-entry execution and planning import one pure model (scripts/verify/business_entry_matrix_model.mjs); the declaration-driven matrix is declared as one unit per entry with the declaration row, overlay behaviour, derived denied-role plan and model/probe revisions in its fingerprint, and a served-bundle revision is provenance, not a validity key, so a redeploy alone never invalidates the set (an impact analysis does, as for any reuse).
